A '''zombie cow''' appeared in [[Ashdale]] during the [[Ashdale Tutorial]], initially appearing as an ordinary dead cow before being reanimated. It must be fought to progress, and was presumably reanimated by [[Morwenna the Cruel]].

It did not count as a cow for [[Slayer assignment]]s.
